independence: Reviewer performed read-only source and evidence review, independent focused test and read-only integrity/database checks. Reviewer did not implement product, harness, browser, or supplemental test changes and authored only these final review files.
scope: Technical acceptance of the exact frozen M3 local PostgreSQL and persistent Mock profile. Integrator decision remains separate.

coverage.method: Independently recomputed from all retained LCOV runs using the reviewed merger and owned-module manifest.

independentExecutions.command: Read-only SELECT version(), current_setting('server_version'); SELECT datname FROM pg_database WHERE datname = ANY(reported supplemental database names)
independentExecutions.postgres: PostgreSQL 17.6 on x86_64-windows, compiled by msvc-19.44.35213, 64-bit

m2Impact.reason: Current identity, workspace, operator/hold, durable-command, credit, schema, and HTTP regression evidence plus reset ownership/credit/command races supports continued M2 local obligations. Historical M2 approval remains scoped to its own bytes; no byte-identical carry-forward is claimed.

findings.resolution: Traceability mapping is now included in contract and validator digests; independent mutation regression test passed.
Premature pre-submit snapshots were excluded. Actual role-reversed snapshot and newly captured one-owner roster, HTTP 200 actions, and revoked-tab denial were inspected.
Three independent reset runs each of ownership, credit reservation, duplicate-command and generation replay contention passed with exact final state and cleanup evidence.
Nested subcases are explicitly mapped, credit race labels are corrected, and PostgreSQL version was independently verified.
Manual crash fixture teardown is not accepted as automatic cleanup proof; separate asset, scheduled cleanup and restart tests supply that evidence.

limitations: Acceptance covers the local persistent Mock profile only. It does not pass real-provider, payment, cloud email, production storage, authenticated provider webhook, or later release gates.
Browser evidence uses the repository development server; isolated production build and live HTTP probes cover the same frozen source separately. Viewport checks are limited to 1440x900 and 390x844.
Expiry and loading evidence uses disclosed scoped fixtures and controlled clocks; this is not a real elapsed-duration or production capacity trial.
The integrity checker alone is not an evidence-authenticity or canonical-denominator proof; this decision additionally checks actual IDs, raw logs, artifacts, source digests and supplemental records.
Future source, schema, lockfile, configuration, policy or validator changes require impact assessment and applicable revalidation.
